notes: BETA is outcome-selected: 240 of 398 test tasks are scored using a test-label minimum-move mask. Chronological separation and decision-date restrictions are reported, but do not establish absence of pretrained-model historical knowledge. Tool-use counts and example traces describe behavior without testing execution validity; no downstream trading utility is evaluated. The benchmark is a contributed evaluation resource, not an ordinary method-evaluation dataset. Retrieval tools are separated from its task-specific forecast contract. Reconciliation additionally records the previously omitted 3,631-demonstration training corpus. Existing ids are retained for the retrieval infrastructure and staged policy training.

changes: Separate reusable market retrieval from the horizon-specific prediction action and BETA scoring contract
Retrieval layer: TSK -> GTS; retain existing id for its infrastructure mechanism
Retrieval dimensions: remove Control, Verification, and Feedback; retain Interface and Interaction and Tools and Execution
Retrieval functions: context_memory and validation -> data_management, processing and validation
Forecast contract: TSK evaluation resource with resource_level view
reconciliation.reason: Sections 2.1 and B describe parameterized historical bars, indicators and ranks that retain their semantics across temporal task families (lines 165-172, 865-873). These are separately reusable from the terminal stock-return target and direction-magnitude scoring contract (lines 173-230, 874). R3 therefore separates GTS retrieval from the TSK benchmark. Historical numerical queries do not substantiate a context-memory mechanism, and no separate execution verifier warrants carrying over the retired feedback dimension.

changes: Retain LLM layer, mechanism, id and model_training role
Remove Optimization and Evolution from dimensions
reconciliation.reason: Full-parameter SFT supervises analysis, tool calls and the terminal forecast (lines 408-410); PPO updates the same policy using realized-return rewards (lines 421-430). R2 and R6 place both stages on the LLM side with no Harness dimensions. The newly recorded demonstration corpus is independently contributed training data (lines 389-404), not a Harness optimization component.

adjudication.summary: The candidate split of reusable point-in-time retrieval (GTS) from the BETA forecast contract (TSK) follows R3 literally. All other modules and evaluation evidence were checked and accepted.
